userMessage: V knižnici SOYER premenuj pieseň "WONDER" na "WONDER (akustická verzia)".

setup.description: Seeds a real library name from data/libraries/ (SOYER is an actual church-band library directory) with one real song title (WONDER.pro exists on disk) so the model must first resolve the library and presentation by name before renaming — it cannot invent a UUID.

slides.main: You are the wonder that I see
You are the reason I believe

expected.notes: Worship CRUD happy path requiring resolve-by-name before write: the model must call list_libraries and/or list_presentations to find the real UUIDs before calling rename_presentation. Tests that it does NOT hallucinate an id, and that the new name is exactly 'WONDER (akustická verzia)'.
